text:
samir: Quick one — can we schedule a split PIR for last night's outage? Thinking 2 parts: 30m tech deep-dive (root cause, logs, fix), then 30m customer-facing summary (impact, comms, mitigations). Need a co-facilitator for the customer readout. Who's available?

incident-bot: [automated] Incident #2026-042: routing overload -> mitigated 03:12 UTC, visible error rate ~15% for ~37m, affected tenants: 3, top customer: Acme Co (latency spikes). Pager escalated to eng-oncall at 02:45 UTC. See incident tracker: https://incidents.company/2026-042

maria: +1 to splitting. I can take the tech deep-dive. Ill prep 10-15m of logs + quick reproducer steps. @lee can you confirm the config change timeline?

alex: Ill own the customer-facing summary. Need a concise timeline and what was communicated (if anything). Can someone paste the outbound snippet we sent to Acme Co?

tj: timezone check — EMEA folks prefer 09:00-11:00 UTC, APAC prefers early UTC (~06:30-08:00). Proposing two slot options so we can pick:
- Option A: 2026-02-15 10:00 UTC (best for EMEA/NA)
- Option B: 2026-02-16 07:30 UTC (better for APAC)
Which works?

olivia: Option A (10:00 UTC) works for me. Id like a co-facilitator from comms on the customer readout so we can speak to next steps externally.

calendar-bot: Poll created — https://calendar.company/poll/2026-042-split-pir (please vote by EOD).

samir: Proposed invite text/agenda (feel free to copy):
```
Title: Incident 2026-042 — Split PIR (Tech deep-dive + Customer readout)
Duration: 60m (2x30m)
Agenda:
  - 00-30m: Tech deep-dive (maria) — timeline, logs, RCA hypothesis, mitigations applied
  - 30-60m: Customer readout (alex + co-fac) — impact summary, messages, next steps for customers
Pre-read (please add to the incident doc):
  - short incident timeline (1 paragraph)
  - top 5 logs/metrics showing the spike
  - mitigations performed and timestamps
  - current action list + owners
```

maria: Ill prepare the logs and a short reproducer. Suggest action owners for follow-ups: restore/gap fix -> @lee, RCA doc -> @maria, customer comms -> @alex. OK?

samir: Sounds good. If the poll is silent by EOD Ill lock in 10:00 UTC and send invites with the above agenda. Thanks all :thumbsup:

tj: Can we loop in support rep @nina for customer context on impact and any open tickets?

alex: Adding Nina to attendees. Ill draft the external brief and share a PR link in the incident doc before the meeting.

incident-bot: Reminder: please add the mitigation timeline and any outbound communications to the incident tracker: https://incidents.company/2026-042. This helps the PIR prep.

olivia: One more ask — can we reserve 10 minutes at the end for action triage (who does what, deadlines)? Keeps the meeting outcome-oriented.

samir: Agreed. Adding "Action triage (10m)" to the end of the agenda. I'll ping again after poll closes. Cheers.
